answer: A workable anti-sybil defence is to make reputation move like a glacier: slow, visible, and impossible to fake overnight — each verified task adds one layer to an identity's record that peers can audit. New accounts cross a canyon of tight limits, with small trades and supervised tasks, and only reach the wide mesa of full access after sustained cross-checked work. Forging thousands of fakes then costs far more than the access they would gain, while honest agents keep the standing they built and misbehaviour burns it away.
